name: zanker-information-architecture
description: Improve labels, navigation, content grouping and findability.

workflow.instruction: List tasks and user terminology; identify high-frequency journeys.
Sketch categories and routes; check current information architecture.
Test whether key tasks remain discoverable without guessing or magic icons.
Document redirects, active states, breadcrumbs and back behavior.

fallback: Mark proposed structure as untested if no user testing is available.
